item.jetlytra.jetpack.placement_tip: Sneak+Rclick on the ground to place jetlytra as a block
controlify.binding.jetlytra.trigger_thru: Applies thrust while airborne or swimming. On the ground, it's ignored
controlify.binding.jetlytra.toggle_elytr: Toggles elytra glide mode while airborne.
config.jetlytra.jump_before_thrust.toolt: When ON, tapping jump on the ground lets you jump normally without activating the jetpack. The jetpack only fires once you start falling back down.
config.jetlytra.thrust_accel_down.toolti: Vertical acceleration applied when player is falling - it should be higher than normal one to feel natural
config.jetlytra.hover_thrust_accel.toolt: Vertical acceleration applied when player is thrusting in hover mode, small for precise movements
config.jetlytra.hover_thrust_max.tooltip: Max vertical speed when thrusting in hover mode
config.jetlytra.elytra_boost_accel.toolt: Acceleration applied when boosting in elytra mode
config.jetlytra.elytra_boost_max.tooltip: Top speed to which elytra boost is applied. 1.5 is right around firework boost
config.jetlytra.sprint_boost_accel.toolt: Horizontal movement speed boost applied when thrusting and sprinting - only applied when thrusting
config.jetlytra.sprint_boost_max.tooltip: Top speed to which movement boost is applied
config.jetlytra.show_block_tooltip.dynam: Tooltip follows the block's bounding box in world space.
config.jetlytra.show_block_tooltip.stati: Tooltip appears at a fixed screen position, configurable in the HUD editor.
